utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive finished yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't heard anything about it yet. Did someone mention it was supposed to be done today?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I thought it was supposed to be ready by today. Have you checked with the repair shop?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, right... I think I might need a hammer, actually. Could you grab me one?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I've got a good one in my garage. I'll be right back with it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear they're organizing a repair drive this weekend? I'm thinking of bringing in that old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds nice, but do we know where exactly it's being held? I'd hate to lug something heavy only to find out it's at the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's at the community center, near the old library. I saw a flyer at the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Opal, what's this about a repair drive? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, you mean the one for the community center's broken generator? I think it's parked behind the old library.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can lend a hand with that. Do you know what tools we'll need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I'm not sure yet. I've got a lot on my plate right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Come on, even an hour would make a big difference. And we'll have snacks!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How can we make this the best one yet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need to set clear time slots and gather tools beforehand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great ideas! Let's finalize a schedule and I can start rounding up tools from neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What's the issue with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, what did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We were just about to discuss the repair drive. What brings you here?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I was thinking we could coordinate drop-offs with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds like a great idea, Faye! I can check the school pickup times and see if we can set up a table right after.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect! Let's aim for right after the 3 PM pickup—that way parents can drop off items while they're already here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: What's this I hear about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's a community event where we fix up broken items together—like a repair café! Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have a broken lamp I've been meaning to fix—could I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What about it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you talking about that broken-down old truck down the street?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that's the one—rusted thing, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What does it involve?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's something about helping fix up people's homes, but I can't quite remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hmm, I wonder who's organizing it. Maybe we could find out more together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm planning to bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a toaster! I'll make sure we have some spare parts on hand. We're expecting a few small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll definitely bring it by around 10. I told my neighbor Sam about it too—he's bringing his blender.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I'm not sure exactly. I just heard some folks are organizing something to help fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A repair drive for the community center? That sounds great. Do you know who's heading it up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, is that the thing for fixing up the community center? I think I signed up for that, but I can't remember...

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that's the one! We're meeting at the community center on Saturday at 10 AM to fix up the place. I'll remind you again closer to the day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great, thanks Vik! I'll definitely need that reminder—my memory's like a sieve these days.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw something about that... did you say it's happening today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it's today. Starts at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, 10 AM? That's like... now? I completely lost track of time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a full set of wrenches and screwdrivers if anyone needs to borrow them for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear, Gus. I'll make a list of who needs what so we don't lose track.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a plan, Eli. Just let me know what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, I heard we're organizing a repair drive this weekend. I can bring some tools and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's fantastic, Mara! We could really use your tools and expertise. I'll spread the word and get everyone on board.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I have a set of screwdrivers and a multimeter I can bring. Do you know what time we're starting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—need any help connecting with other local groups?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules. I know a few groups that could use some collaboration, like the tool library on Elm Street and the community garden's repair cafe.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I know folks at both places! Let me reach out to them this week to see if they're interested.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I'm so glad you're here to talk about the neighborhood repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa! I've been going over our inventory, and we're a bit low on some basic items for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I see. Do you have a list of what we're missing? I can put out a call for donations to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community event where people bring broken items and we fix them together to reduce waste.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds neat! Do you think I could bring my old toaster that's been acting up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's a community event where we collect broken items and fix them together, like bikes, electronics, or clothes. Want to help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds cool, but I'm pretty swamped. Let me know the date and I'll see if I can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira! I'm Sam. I heard you're organizing a repair drive—how can I lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, you're interested in the repair drive? Do you actually know how to fix things, or are you just looking to hang out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got some experience—fixed my own lawnmower and a few toasters. Happy to put that to use for the drive.
